lines.en: label yumispring8:
scene yumigetshermoneymaybe1
It takes a lot to humble a person. Sometimes, even a death.
lines.zh: 要让一个人谦卑下来，需要很多东西。有时候，甚至需要一场死亡。

lines.en: Which isn’t to say Yumi’s mother had already died. There’s no need to fret about that just yet.
lines.zh: 这并不是说 Yumi 的母亲已经死了。现在还不用为那个操心。

lines.en: But it was this brush with death and the first taste of its breath as it leans in for a kiss that had started to change her in a way.
lines.zh: 但正是这次与死亡的擦肩、第一次尝到它俯身要吻下来时那口气，开始让她有了某种改变。

lines.en: It wasn’t a big way. She still thought she was better than everyone. She still wanted to be left alone.
lines.zh: 改变不大。她还是觉得自己比谁都强。她还是想一个人待着。

lines.en: But every once in a while, there would be a less self-destructive thought. Normally about a thing she hopes to do or see or just {i}experience{/i} before {i}her{/i} time here comes to an end.
lines.zh: 但偶尔，会冒出一个不那么自我毁灭的念头。通常是关于在{i}她{/i}这儿的日子走到尽头之前，她希望能做、能看、或者只是{i}体验{/i}一下的某件事。

lines.en: This complicated things though, because she didn’t know if her life {i}could{/i} come to an end anymore.
lines.zh: 不过这把事情搞复杂了，因为她现在不确定自己的人生还{i}会不会{/i}走到尽头。

lines.en: So sometimes, after the last bell rang, she’d wander the halls of the school in circles, trying to circumnavigate her head in addition to the third floor.
lines.zh: 所以有时候，在最后的铃声响过之后，她会在学校的走廊里一圈圈地转，试图绕开自己的脑袋，顺便绕开三楼。

lines.en: Sometimes, it’d led her right back home. Sometimes, to work.
lines.zh: 有时候，这把她带回家。有时候，带到上班的地方。

lines.en: But on this particular day, it led her somewhere else.
lines.zh: 但在这一天，它把她带到了别的地方。

lines.en: : Oh, Yumi. There you are.
lines.zh: : 哦，Yumi。你在这儿啊。

lines.en: scene black
scene yumigetshermoneymaybe2
Today, she’d be led to {i}another{/i} princess — one far closer to the title than Yumi ever felt because she’d seen several men have their fingers lopped off by now. And Touka probably hadn’t.
lines.zh: 今天，她会被带到{i}另一位{/i}公主面前——一位远比 Yumi 自己感觉的更配得上这个称号的公主，因为她到现在已经见过好几个男人的手指被砍掉了。而 Touka大概没见过。

lines.en: : You left last period before I had a chance to get your attention. What are your plans now that school has ended?
lines.zh: : 你最后一节课就走了，我还没来得及叫住你。学校放学了，你有什么打算？

lines.en: : Yumi?
lines.zh: : Yumi？

lines.en: : Why are you talkin’ to me? We don’t talk. This is weird.
lines.zh: : 你干嘛跟我说话？我们又不说话。这也太怪了。

lines.en: : I apologize if my presence is somewhat of an annoyance to you. I was just operating under the assumption that you’d want money as being poor seems to be quite detrimental to your attitude.
lines.zh: : 如果我的出现对你来说有点烦人，我先道歉。我只是假设你会想要钱，因为「穷」似乎对你的态度影响很大。

lines.en: : Ya know, I’ve shaken down my fair share of girls for lunch money before, but this has gotta be the first time one has just come over without me even lifting a finger.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我为了午饭钱也敲诈过不少女生，但像这样一个手指都没抬、人家就自己凑过来的，还真是头一回。

lines.en: : Please don’t hit me. I am merely a messenger today.
lines.zh: : 请别打我。我今天只是个信使。

lines.en: : And now shit’s somehow even weirder. Listen, I know I’m {i}technically{/i} Yakuza and shit, but I don’t go around doing collections. So if you’re trying to pass over somebody’s protection money-
lines.zh: : 现在这事更他妈的怪了。听着，我知道我{i}理论上{/i}算是黑帮什么的，可我不会到处去收账。所以你要是想转交什么人的保护费——

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe3
: I assure you this has nothing to do with {i}protection{/i} money. Unless Tsukasa has decided to take your business idea in a new and rather odd direction.
lines.zh: : 我向你保证，这跟{i}保护{/i}费一点关系都没有。除非 Tsukasa 把你们的生意点子带到了一个又新又怪的方向。

lines.en: : Tsukasa? Business? You mean-
lines.zh: : Tsukasa？生意？你是说——

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe4
: You’re still owed $10,000, are you not? I’ve been asked to finalize the transaction today. Which would require you to accompany me to the manor for a brief-
lines.zh: : 你还欠着 $10,000 没拿到，对吧？我今天被要求把这笔交易结清。这需要你陪我去一趟宅邸，简短地——

lines.en: : Yeah, whatever the fuck you want, I’ll do it. Throw me in a god damn dumpster for all I care. $10k is $10k. I ain’t gonna argue.
lines.zh: : 行，你他妈的想怎样都行，我做。把我扔进该死的垃圾箱都行，我才不在乎。一万刀就是一万刀。我不跟你争。

lines.en: : Is $10,000 really such an extravagant amount to you that you’d throw yourself in the trash for it?
lines.zh: : $10,000 对你来说真的算一笔大钱吗，大到你能为了它把自己扔进垃圾堆？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe5
: Oh. Is your family just...not very {i}good{/i} at being Yakuza then? Because that really does not seem like much to me.
lines.zh: : 哦。那你们家是不是……不太{i}擅长{/i}当黑帮啊？因为在我看来这真不算多。

lines.en: : I don’t fuckin’ take my dad’s filthy money. Most of the time at least. So just point me in the direction of your god damn manor, cause I figured I was just never gettin’ this payout at all.
lines.zh: : 我他妈的不拿我爸那些脏钱。大多数时候至少不拿。所以你直接告诉我你家那该死的宅邸往哪儿走，因为我本来以为这笔钱我永远都拿不到了。

lines.en: : There’s a limo waiting outside that’ll take us there together. But if that makes you uncomfortable-
lines.zh: : 外面有辆 limo 等着，会载我们一起过去。不过要是那让你不舒服——

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe6
: Nope. Where the fuck’s this limo? Courtyard? On my way.
lines.zh: : 不会。那辆破 limo 在哪儿？中庭？我这就去。

lines.en: : Wow...all this obedience for pocket change?
lines.zh: : 哇……这点零花钱就能让你这么听话？

lines.en: : I wonder if this is how kidnapping works?
lines.zh: : 我在想，绑架是不是就是这么运作的？

lines.en: scene black
scene yumigetshermoneymaybe7
: Do you really come to school in this fuckin’ thing every day? Why don’t you just walk? Too {i}good{/i} for that or something?
lines.zh: : 你真的每天坐这破玩意儿来上学？你为什么不直接走路？嫌走路{i}掉价{/i}还是怎么的？

lines.en: : My mother doesn’t want me walking to school. She says I’d attract too large of a ransom if someone were to swipe me off the sidewalk.
lines.zh: : 我妈妈不让我走路上学。她说要是有人把我从人行道上掳走，会招来太高的赎金。

lines.en: : Weird. Figured there wasn’t any number “too large” for your family.
lines.zh: : 怪了。我还以为对你们家来说，没什么数字算「太高」。

lines.en: : There isn’t, which is how I know she’s lying for the sake of my safety.
lines.zh: : 是没有，所以我才知道她是为了我的安全在撒谎。

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe8
: I do still walk to school {i}sometimes,{/i} though. And I haven’t been stolen {i}yet.{/i} So I must be doing something right.
lines.zh: : 不过我{i}有时候{/i}还是会走路上学。而且{i}到现在{/i}也没被偷走。所以我一定是做对了点什么。

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe9
: Pfft. Probably because we ain’t got a rapist as a teacher anymore. Guarantee you you’d be singin’ a different tune if Sensei was still around.
lines.zh: : 噗。大概是因为我们这儿再也没个强奸犯当老师了。我敢保证，要是 Sensei 还在，你就不会这么说了。

lines.en: : You say that as if he doesn’t know where I live.
lines.zh: : 你说得好像他不知道我住哪儿似的。

lines.en: : Probably just forgot. You know how that guy is.
lines.zh: : 大概忘了吧。你知道他那个人什么德行。

lines.en: : If it ain’t him, it’d be somebody else though. Your mom’s probably right to keep you away from doin’ shit that could put you in danger. Mine would throw me to the god damn wolves for a six-pack.
lines.zh: : 不过就算不是他，也会有别人。你妈不让你去做那些可能让你陷入危险的事，大概是对的。我妈会为了一箱啤酒把我扔进狼堆里。

lines.en: : Something tells me you’d have no trouble defending yourself from a few {i}wolves{/i} if it really came down to that, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 我有种感觉，真到了那一步，你要对付几头{i}狼{/i}也完全不在话下，Yumi。

lines.en: : Yeah, and something tells me you’ve got snipers on every building in Kumon-mi ready to blast out the brains of any dude who so much as talks to you.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我也有种感觉，你在 Kumon-mi 每一栋楼上都安排了狙击手，随时准备把任何一个跟你搭话的男人的脑袋轰开花。

lines.en: : Oh, heavens no.
lines.zh: : 哦，天哪，才没有。

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe10
: There are several blind spots the snipers can’t reach. I just need to make sure I avoid them.
lines.zh: : 狙击手够不着的地方有好几个呢。我只要注意避开那些地方就行了。

lines.en: : Nice. Real comforting knowing I’m one sneeze away from getting shot.
lines.zh: : 好极了。知道自己一个喷嚏就要挨枪子儿，真让人安心。

lines.en: : Just don’t sneeze and everything will be fine then.
lines.zh: : 那你别打喷嚏就万事大吉了。

lines.en: : Besides, I’m in just as much danger as you are right now. Mother makes it sound as if your family is a much bigger deal than you make them out to be.
lines.zh: : 再说，我现在跟你一样危险。母亲说起来，好像你们家比你讲的要厉害得多。

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe11
: They probably are. Means nothing to me, though. I don’t want to get wrapped up in any of that bullshit.
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。不过对我来说什么都不是。我不想被卷进那些狗屁倒灶的事里。

lines.en: : Understandable. But it doesn’t change the fact that anyone who’d harm even a single hair on your head would wind up with a target on their back.
lines.zh: : 可以理解。但改变不了一个事实——任何伤害你一根头发的人，背上都会多一个靶子。

lines.en: : Not {i}anyone.{/i} Just the ones who haven’t fucked my dad.
lines.zh: : 也不是{i}任何人{/i}。只是那些没跟我爸上过床的。

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe12
: Well, unless your father has secretly been Sensei this whole time, I can’t imagine that cancels out {i}that{/i} many people.
lines.zh: : 嗯，除非你父亲一直 secretly 是 Sensei，不然我想这排除不了{i}多少{/i}人。

lines.en: : Ew. Don’t even joke about that. You’ve seen his fuckin’ niece-daughter thing. I wouldn’t wish that dude’s fatherhood on anybody.
lines.zh: : 呕。别拿这个开玩笑。你见过他那套侄女女儿的玩意儿。我才不会希望任何人摊上那个家伙当爹。

lines.en: : Hmm...
: Perhaps he just needs a mother’s help then?
lines.zh: : 也许他只是需要一个母亲的帮助？

lines.en: scene black
: What he needs is a fuckin’ vasectomy. Maybe a lobotomy too. Think there’s some kinda procedure where you can knock out both of those things at once?
lines.zh: : 他需要的是他妈的结扎。也许再顺便来个脑叶切除。你说有没有哪种手术能一次把这两样都搞定？

lines.en: : Heh...I’m not sure. But I’ll keep an eye out...
lines.zh: : 呵……我不确定。不过我会留意的……

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe13
: God damn....has your place {i}always{/i} been this big?
lines.zh: : 天哪……你们家{i}一直{/i}都这么大吗？

lines.en: : You’ve been here before, haven’t you? Dorm Wars. Christmas.
lines.zh: : 你以前来过的，不是吗？宿舍大战。圣诞节。

lines.en: : Never through the main entrance. And I definitely ain’t ever seen whatever {i}that{/i} fuckin’ part of the house is.
lines.zh: : 从来没从正门进来过。而且{i}那{/i}栋该死的部分我绝对没见过。

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe14
: Ahh, yes. You must be looking at the pleasure wing.
lines.zh: : 啊，对。你看到的应该是「欢乐翼」。

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe15
: The what now?
lines.zh: : 那是什么鬼？

lines.en: : This manor’s been around for quite a while, Yumi. And it wasn’t uncommon centuries ago for courtesans to be housed within the grounds for...easier access.
lines.zh: : 这座宅邸有些年头了，Yumi。几个世纪前，在园子里养着一批高级妓女并不罕见，为了……方便出入。

lines.en: : What you’re looking at is the remnants of that. And exactly where we’re going today.
lines.zh: : 你现在看到的就是那些的遗迹。也正是我们今天要去的地方。

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe16
: On second thought, I would like to leave.
lines.zh: : 我想了想，我想走了。

lines.en: : Hahah! Oh, don’t worry. It’s mostly just miscellaneous rooms in there now. We don’t have {i}courtesans{/i} anymore.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！哦，别担心。现在里面 basically 就是些杂七杂八的房间。我们已经不养{i}妓女{/i}了。

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe17
: There {i}is{/i} a private massage room, though. But I wouldn’t recommend going there unless you want to come out with a little less dignity than you had going in.
lines.zh: : 不过{i}有{/i}一间私人按摩室。但我建议别去，除非你想出来的时候比进去时少一点尊严。

lines.en: : Uhh...yeah. I’m good. Thanks. Wh...Why are we going there, though? Ain’t you just gonna give me my money and tell me to fuck off or something?
lines.zh: : 呃……行。我不用了，谢了。不……不过我们为什么要去那儿？你不就是把钱给我、然后叫我滚蛋之类的吗？

lines.en: : After a brief meeting, I presume. I told you — I’m merely a messenger today. It’s my mother who summoned you here. {i}She’s{/i} the one you’ll want to direct your questions to.
lines.zh: : 我猜，是在一场简短的会面之后。我说过了——我今天只是个信使。是我母亲把你叫来的。你有什么问题，该问的是{i}她{/i}。

lines.en: : Your mom? You mean that rich lady from the Shark Tank thing? I’ve got to talk to {i}her?{/i} Why do we need to get adults involved at all? Just give me the cash and tell me to beat it.
lines.zh: : 你妈？你是说那个 Shark Tank 上的富婆？我得跟{i}她{/i}谈？为什么非得把大人扯进来？直接把钱给我、叫我滚不就行了。

lines.en: : I apologize, Yumi. But I’m afraid I can’t do that.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Yumi。恐怕我不能那么做。

lines.en: scene black
: Now, follow me. I’ll guide you to the secondary meeting room.
lines.zh: : 现在，跟我来。我带你去第二会客室。

lines.en: : But once we arrive, you’re on your own...
lines.zh: : 不过到了那儿，你就得靠自己了……

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe18
It takes a lot to humble a person. But sometimes, just stained glass windows and fancy clocks will do the trick.
lines.zh: 要让一个人谦卑下来，需要很多东西。但有时候，光是彩绘玻璃窗和精致的钟就能做到。

lines.en: Combine that with a silence that feels somehow {i}bigger{/i} than any silence she’d ever felt before and you’ll wind up with a situation where Yumi Yamaguchi can’t {i}help{/i} but feel humbled.
lines.zh: 再加上一种比她以往感受过的任何寂静都{i}更大{/i}的寂静，你就会得到一个让 Yumi Yamaguchi {i}不由自主{/i}感到自身渺小的局面。

lines.en: This was nothing like the manor {i}she{/i} knew. It was emptier. Quieter. Bigger and brighter and less openly intimidating.
lines.zh: 这跟{i}她{/i}认识的那座宅邸完全不同。它更空。更安静。更大、更明亮，也不那么明目张胆地吓人。

lines.en: But that somehow made it feel {i}more{/i} intimidating. And the lack of people only emphasized the silence that bothered her.
lines.zh: 可这不知怎么反而让它{i}更{/i}吓人。而人少这一点，只更加凸显了那让她不安的寂静。

lines.en: There was a voice in her head that would always keep her occupied when her mind started drifting nowadays, but it appeared that voice was fearful too.
lines.zh: 如今她的思绪一开始飘走，脑子里总有个声音会让她不得空闲，可现在那个声音似乎也在害怕。

lines.en: So right now, it was {i}only{/i} her. Waiting. For someone. {i}Anyone{/i} to come and give her salvation in the form of noise or company or {i}anything{/i} that would make this room feel smaller.
lines.zh: 所以此刻，{i}只{/i}剩她一个人。等着。等着某个人。任何一个人来，用声音、陪伴、或者任何能让这间屋子感觉小一点的东西，赐予她救赎。

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe19
It was then that her prayers were answered. Footsteps. {i}Familiar{/i} footsteps.
lines.zh: 就在那时，她的祈祷应验了。脚步声。{i}熟悉{/i}的脚步声。

lines.en: But who they stemmed from seemed anything {i}but{/i} familiar.
lines.zh: 可那脚步声的来源，似乎{i}一点也不{/i}熟悉。

lines.en: scene black
scene yumigetshermoneymaybe20
scene yumigetshermoneymaybe21
: Hey...Yumi.
lines.zh: : 嘿……Yumi。

lines.en: scene black
scene yumigetshermoneymaybe22
: Who the fuck are you and why do you know my name?
lines.zh: : 你他妈的是谁，怎么知道我的名字？

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe23
: Because I {i}chose{/i} it, you piece of shit. I’m your fucking mother.
lines.zh: : 因为这名字是我{i}选{/i}的，你这狗东西。我是你他妈的妈。

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe24
: Wha-
: Now, I know you probably have a lot of questions-
lines.zh: : 现在，我知道你大概有一堆问题——

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe25
: Oh, what gave you {i}that{/i} idea?!
lines.zh: : 哦，是什么让你{i}这么想{/i}的？！

lines.en: : Yumi, I will explain everything. I just need you to try and listen for once in your god damn life.
lines.zh: : Yumi，我会把一切都解释清楚。我只求你这一辈子哪怕就一次，试着听我说。

lines.en: : The fuck do you know about {i}my{/i} life, Yuki?! Apart from just how to keep fucking it up, I mean!
lines.zh: : 你他妈的懂{i}我的{/i}人生什么，Yuki？！除了怎么一直把它搞砸之外，我是说！

lines.en: : Do you want to yell at me for a little while longer, or can I talk now?
lines.zh: : 你想再多骂我一会儿，还是可以让我说了？

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe26
: Make it quick...I’ve got a meeting.
lines.zh: : 长话短说……我还有个会要开。

lines.en: : Yumi, this {i}is{/i} the meeting. You were set up. But I’ll talk to Tsubasa about getting you your money later since I know that fuckin’ brat of hers never delivered on her promise.
lines.zh: : Yumi，这{i}就是{/i}那个会。你是被设局叫来的。不过我回头会跟 Tsubasa 说，把你的钱给你，因为我知道她那个小崽子从来没兑现过她的承诺。

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe27
: {b}OH, FUCK THE MONEY! I WENT THIS LONG WITHOUT IT, DIDN’T I?! AIN’T LIKE IT’S GONNA FUCKIN’ CHANGE ANYTHING!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}去他妈的钱！我没拿那钱也过了这么久，不是吗？！它他妈的也改变不了什么！{/b}

lines.en: : Okay...{i}fuck{/i} the money then. Let’s talk about the elephant in the room. I have cancer. And I am sorry you had to find out from a fucking {i}bill{/i} instead of me.
lines.zh: : 行吧……那就{i}去他妈的{/i}钱。我们来说说屋里那头大象吧。我得了癌症。很抱歉你是从一张该死的{i}账单{/i}上知道的，而不是从我嘴里。

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe28
: Why didn’t you say anything?...
lines.zh: : 你为什么什么都不说？……

lines.en: : Because I’m a fucking shit mom, obviously.
lines.zh: : 因为我就是个他妈的糟糕妈，很明显。

lines.en: : You were just going to hide it then? Let me...what, watch you slowly decompose and just assume that everything is {i}fine?{/i} Do you think I’m a fucking idiot?!
lines.zh: : 所以你就打算瞒着？让我……什么，眼睁睁看着你慢慢烂掉，还得假定一切都{i}好？{/i}你以为我是傻逼吗？！

lines.en: : I wasn’t going to {i}hide{/i} it. And yeah, you might be an idiot, but you’re not {i}that{/i} much of an idiot. I’d have told you eventually. I just...didn’t know when eventually {i}was.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我没打算{i}瞒{/i}着你。还有，对，你可能是个傻子，但还没傻到那个程度。我早晚会告诉你的。只是……我不知道「早晚」是什么时候。

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe29
: I didn’t...want it to be real. And there were still tests that needed to be done and...I just...hadn’t accepted it yet.
lines.zh: : 我……不想让它变成真的。而且还有检查要做，还有……我只是……还没接受它。

lines.en: : So...you don’t know for sure yet? There are still tests? Then it’s...there’s a chance you {i}don’t{/i} have it?
lines.zh: : 所以……你还{i}不{/i}确定？还有检查要做？那就是说……有可能你其实没得？

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe30
: There’s a chance...right?
lines.zh: : 还有可能对吧？

lines.en: : I {i}do{/i} have it, Yumi. Tsubasa took me to her personal doctor for some more testing and they...confirmed that I {i}do{/i} have lung cancer.
lines.zh: : 我{i}确实{/i}得了，Yumi。Tsubasa 带我去了她的私人医生那儿做了更多检查，他们……确认我{i}确实{/i}得了肺癌。

lines.en: : But it is {i}not{/i} a death sentence. And I...will {i}probably{/i} be okay.
lines.zh: : 但这不是死刑判决。而且我……{i}大概{/i}会没事的。

lines.en: : {i}Probably?{/i}
scene yumigetshermoneymaybe31
: I need surgery and...there are...always risks to that, if I’m understanding correctly. And cancer’s kinda notorious for just...coming back, so...
lines.zh: : 我需要做手术，而且……据我所知，那总是有风险的。而且癌症出了名地会……复发，所以……

lines.en: : Even {i}if{/i} everything goes well, there’s a chance shit might get worse all over again.
lines.zh: : {i}就算{/i}一切顺利，也有可能一切又变得更糟。

lines.en: : And I ain’t sure how much time I’ve got left here in the long run, but...I think this is just a thing I’m gonna have to fuckin’ deal with forever now.
lines.zh: : 而且我不确定长远来看我还剩多少时间，但是……我想这就是我从现在开始得他妈的一辈子面对的东西了。

lines.en: : You fucking idiot...
lines.zh: : 你这个白痴……

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe32
: It gets worse...
lines.zh: : 还有更糟的……

lines.en: : Than {i}cancer?!{/i} How?!
lines.zh: : 比{i}癌症{/i}更糟？！怎么会？！

lines.en: : Well...I did what I always do when shit ain’t goin’ my way. Started using again. So now I’ve gotta quit drugs {i}and{/i} fight back against a disease that’s trying to consume my insides.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我干了每次事情不顺时都会干的事。又开始嗑药了。所以现在我不光得戒毒，{i}还{/i}得跟一个想从里面把我吃空的病对抗。

lines.en: : Go on. Let’s hear it. What shitty name are you gonna call me this time?
lines.zh: : 来吧。让我听听。这次你打算骂我什么难听的？

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe33
scene yumigetshermoneymaybe34
: Yumi?...
lines.zh: : Yumi？……

lines.en: : I can’t believe you didn’t tell me...
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信你没告诉我……

lines.en: : So...what? You just fucking...did all that on your own? Would I have really just made things {i}worse?{/i}
lines.zh: : 所以……怎样？你就他妈的……一个人扛了所有这些？我在的话真的只会让事情{i}更糟{/i}吗？

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe35
: What? No! That’s not it at all. I’ve just...you know me. I’ve always done shit {i}alone.{/i} And this was the first time I’ve ever had to do {i}this{/i}, so I just...blanked.
lines.zh: : 什么？不是！根本不是那么回事。我只是……你了解我的。我什么事都是{i}一个人{/i}扛。而这是我这辈子第一次要面对{i}这种{/i}事，所以我就……脑子一片空白。

lines.en: : How the fuck was I supposed to know you were gonna open my mail? I thought I’d have more time to figure out how to tell you.
lines.zh: : 我他妈的怎么会知道你会拆我的信？我以为我还有更多时间想清楚怎么跟你开口。

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe36
: Then once you {i}did{/i} find out...I thought it’d be easier on you to just fuckin’...fade away. That’s why I changed the locks...stopped reaching out...
lines.zh: : 后来你{i}真{/i}知道了……我又觉得，让你好过一点的方式就是干脆他妈的……慢慢消失。所以我换了锁……不再联系你……

lines.en: : Thought you’d be fine with me just being randomly gone again since I’ve already put you through that before.
lines.zh: : 想着你大概能接受我又一次莫名其妙地消失，毕竟我以前就让你经历过一次。

lines.en: : But that {i}too{/i} was just...
lines.zh: : 可那{i}也{/i}只不过是……

lines.en: : It’s all just me being scared...
lines.zh: : 这一切都只是因为我在害怕……

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe37
: Nobody teaches you how you’re supposed to handle this shit...
lines.zh: : 没人教过你该怎么处理这种破事……

lines.en: : Just literally...{i}everything{/i} went wrong at once. And I’ve always been able to handle everything that comes my way, but...
lines.zh: : 真的就是……{i}所有事{/i}一下子全砸下来了。我向来什么都能扛，可是……

lines.en: : It was just fucking {i}everything,{/i} Yumi. {i}I’m sorry.{/i} I {i}really{/i} am. I’m not cut out to be a mom. We both know this.
lines.zh: : 这次是他妈的{i}一切，{/i}Yumi。{i}对不起。{/i}{i}真的{/i}很对不起。我不是当妈的料。我们俩都知道。

lines.en: : So...what now?
lines.zh: : 那……现在怎么办？

lines.en: : Start...prepping for getting my lungs cut up, I guess?
lines.zh: : 开始……为把肺切掉做准备吧，我猜？

lines.en: : No, like...
lines.zh: : 不，我是说……

lines.en: : Are you going to keep ignoring me?
lines.zh: : 你还要继续不理我吗？

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe38
: Well, you don’t...{i}want{/i} me...do you? Because you never have. And I’ve never {i}blamed{/i} you for that. Which means you definitely wouldn’t want me now that I’m...{i}this.{/i}
lines.zh: : 嗯，你又……不{i}想要{/i}我吧？因为你从来就没想要过。而我也从来没{i}怪{/i}过你。那就意味着，在我变成现在{i}这样{/i}之后，你更不会想要我了。

lines.en: : Right?...
: What do {i}you{/i} want?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}想要什么？

lines.en: : You’re the one who’s fuckin’ dying. You should get to choose.
lines.zh: : 你才是那个他妈的要死的人。该你选。

lines.en: : I just want whatever makes you happy...
lines.zh: : 我只想要能让你开心的东西……

lines.en: : And also for you to stop saying I’m dying since I’m trying to have some hope for once.
lines.zh: : 还有，别再说我快死了，因为我这次想抱点希望。

lines.en: : That...
: That $10,000 that Tsukasa owes me...I can put it toward your-
lines.zh: : 那 Tsukasa 欠我的 $10,000……我可以拿去给你——

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe39
: No. That is {i}your{/i} money. Not mine.
lines.zh: : 不行。那是{i}你的{/i}钱。不是我的。

lines.en: : Can I not choose what to do with my own money?! I want to help! And if money helps, I’ll-
lines.zh: : 我还不能自己决定怎么花自己的钱了吗？！我想帮忙！如果钱能帮上忙，我就——

lines.en: : Money’s not an issue, okay? Tsubasa is taking care of it. If you really want to help, just...don’t hate me, please. That’s literally all I ask, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 钱不是问题，好吗？Tsubasa 在负责。你要是真想帮忙，就……别恨我，拜托。我真的只求这个，Yumi。

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe40
: I’ve never {i}wanted{/i} to hurt you. I just...{i}have.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我从来没{i}想过{/i}要伤害你。我只是……伤害到了。

lines.en: : I don’t hate you anymore...I used to, maybe. But now, I...
lines.zh: : 我不恨你了……也许以前恨过。但现在，我……

lines.en: : I’m scared too...
lines.zh: : 我也很害怕……

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe41
: Wh...Why the fuck’s that rich lady helpin’ you, though? How the hell do {i}you{/i} two know each other?
lines.zh: : 不……不过那个富婆为什么要帮{i}你{/i}？你俩到底是怎么认识的？

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe42
: God, now {i}that’s{/i} a fuckin’ story. Two of us go back to before you were even born.
lines.zh: : 天啊，{i}这{/i}可说来话长了。我俩的认识要追溯到你还出生之前。

lines.en: : That long ago? Why didn’t you ever say anything? You knew her daughter was in my class, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 那么久以前？你为什么从来没提过？你知道她女儿跟我同班吧？

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe43
: Just one of those things you look back on and sorta...want to keep in the past, you know?
lines.zh: : 就是那种回头看的时候，会有点……想让它留在过去的事，你懂吗？

lines.en: : Not really, no.
lines.zh: : 不太懂，不。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...you’re still young. Maybe you’ll have somethin’ like that one day too.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那是因为你还年轻。也许有一天你也会有那种事。

lines.en: : Point is, she cares about me for reasons I ain’t ever gonna fully understand. And I {i}really{/i} didn’t want to drag her back into my shit, but...
lines.zh: : 重点是，她关心我，理由我永远也搞不懂。而我{i}真的{/i}不想把她拖回我这一摊烂事里，但是……

lines.en: : I ain’t gonna stop her from draggin’ {i}herself{/i} in. ‘Specially now that I kinda need all the help I can get.
lines.zh: : 可她要{i}自己{/i}往里跳，我也拦不住。尤其是在我现在多少需要所有能得到的帮助的时候。

lines.en: : She’s not going to make you work in a sketchy massage room to pay her back, is she?
lines.zh: : 她不会让你去那间可疑的按摩室干活抵债吧？

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe44
: Ugh, worse. She made me do {i}this.{/i} My hair hasn’t been black since I was a fuckin’ kid.
lines.zh: : 呃，更糟。她让我干了{i}这个。{/i}我从还是个小屁孩起头发就没黑过。

lines.en: : So she’s...paying for your cancer treatment and...all she asked you to do was take the bleach out of your hair?
lines.zh: : 所以她……替你付癌症治疗的钱，而……她只要求你把头发里的漂染剂洗掉？

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe45
: That’s Tsubasa for you. Tried gettin’ me to do the same shit decades ago. Girl was probably just {i}waiting{/i} for me to get cancer so she could swoop in and give me a makeover.
lines.zh: : Tsubasa 就是这样。几十年前她就想让我干同样的事。那丫头大概就{i}等{/i}着我得癌症，好趁机冲进来给我改造一番。

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe46
: Road to recovery’s just startin’, though....and there’s a long fuckin’ way to go.
lines.zh: : 不过康复之路才刚起步……而且还有他妈的很长一段路要走。

lines.en: : So hey — maybe she makes me dye it pink next? Or even worse — what if she makes me wear a {i}dress?{/i}
lines.zh: : 所以嘿——也许她下次会让我染成粉色？或者更糟——万一她让我穿{i}裙子{/i}呢？

lines.en: : I’m glad you’re not dying, Yuki...but I’d be a little {i}more{/i} glad if you wouldn’t hold my neck like that.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴你没死，Yuki……但你要是别那样勒着我脖子，我会{i}更{/i}高兴一点。

lines.en: : And also maybe {i}tell{/i} me the next time you come down with a disease or start doing drugs again.
lines.zh: : 还有下次你得病、或者又开始嗑药的时候，也许可以{i}告诉{/i}我一声。

lines.en: : Indulge me, will you? We ain’t had many opportunities to hug. And I ain’t gonna force that on you, so the least you can do is just stand there while I do {i}this.{/i}
lines.zh: : 就让我放纵一下，行吗？我们没多少机会拥抱。而且我不会强迫你，所以你至少可以就这么站着让我{i}抱一下。{/i}

lines.en: : ...Fine. But I’m still not happy about it.
lines.zh: : ……行吧。但我还是不高兴。

lines.en: : You ain’t cryin’ anymore, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你没在哭了。

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe47
: M-Me?! I didn’t cry! {i}You{/i} cried!
lines.zh: : 我——我？！我才没哭！是{i}你{/i}哭了！

lines.en: : Me? Hell no! I ain’t cried a day in my life! You on drugs too now?!
lines.zh: : 我？放屁！我这辈子一天都没哭过！你也嗑药嗑傻了吗？！

lines.en: scene black
: Ugh! I changed my mind! Let go of me. I need to go hunt down a little kid for $10,000.
lines.zh: : 呃！我改主意了！放开我。我得去找个小屁孩要那一万刀了。

lines.en: : Do you have the app? I can show you where her room is.
lines.zh: : 你有那个 app 吗？我可以告诉你她房间在哪儿。

lines.en: : No, I don’t- oh. Wait, yeah. I still have it from the last time I was here. Where is it exactly?
lines.zh: : 不，我没有——哦。等等，有。我上次来之后还留着。具体在哪儿？

lines.en: : It’s...{i}that{/i} one. West wing. First floor. Go easy on her. It’s bad form if my daughter kills my friend’s daughter.
lines.zh: : 是……{i}那一间{/i}。西翼。一层。对她下手轻点。要是我女儿杀了我朋友的女儿，那可太难看了。

lines.en: : I’ll see what I can do...
lines.zh: : 我尽量吧……

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe48
: Oh, Yuki! You’re back. How did it go?
lines.zh: : 哦，Yuki！你回来了。怎么样？

lines.en: : It went...well, I think. It was...tough breaking the news to her, but-
lines.zh: : 挺……顺利，我想。要跟她说这个消息很难，不过——

lines.en: : No, not that. Your hair. What did she think about your {i}hair?{/i}
lines.zh: : 不，不是那个。你的头发。她觉得你的{i}头发{/i}怎么样？

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe49
: Oh. Fine, I guess?
lines.zh: : 哦。还行吧，大概？

lines.en: : Fine?
lines.zh: : 还行？

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe50
: But you look so much cuter with your natural color. It’s almost like we’re real sisters now.
lines.zh: : 可你本来的发色可爱多了。现在我们简直像真正的姐妹了。

lines.en: : All these years later and you still haven’t changed, Nee-sama.
lines.zh: : 这么多年过去了，你还是一点没变，Nee-sama。

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe51
: All these years later and you’re still calling me that. Why? It wasn’t necessary then and it isn’t necessary now.
lines.zh: : 这么多年过去了，你还是这么叫我。为什么？那时候没必要，现在也没必要。

lines.en: : Same deal with you looking after me and here we are.
lines.zh: : 你照顾我也是一样，可我们不还是走到了这一步。

lines.en: : I call you by your real name behind the scenes if that helps, though.
lines.zh: : 不过在私下里，我用你的真名称呼你，要是这能让你好受点的话。

lines.en: : Say it now. I’m not sure I’ve ever heard it in your voice before.
lines.zh: : 现在就说。我不确定有没有听你用那个声音叫过。

lines.en: : Nee-sama.
lines.zh: : Nee-sama。

lines.en: scene yumigetshermoneymaybe52
: Hmph. Maybe I’ll just let you die if that’s how things are going to be?
lines.zh: : 哼。要是事情是这样的话，也许我就让你死了算了？

lines.en: : You probably should. But can I least bleach my hair again so I can die with dignity?
lines.zh: : 你大概该这么做。但我至少能再漂一次头发，好死得体面点吗？

lines.en: : No. You may not.
lines.zh: : 不行。你不能。

lines.en: scene black
: Now, come. I’ve taken the evening off and you will be going swimming with me.
lines.zh: : 现在，来吧。我今晚推掉了安排，你要陪我去游泳。

lines.en: : Other people have gotten their teeth kicked in for giving me commands like that, you know.
lines.zh: : 你知道吧，别人用这种语气命令我，牙都被踢掉过。

lines.en: : Ooooh? Are you saying you’re going to {i}attack{/i} me? With so many of my guards around? {i}Yuki.{/i} You really {i}are{/i} a bad girl, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦？你是说你要{i}袭击{/i}我？当着我这么多保镖的面？{i}Yuki。{/i}你可{i}真是{/i}个坏女孩，不是吗？

lines.en: : And you’re just as {i}prissy{/i} as ever, Nee-sama.
lines.zh: : 而你还是跟以前一样{i}矫情{/i}，Nee-sama。

lines.en: : We make a good couple.
lines.zh: : 我们挺般配的。

lines.en: : Now, if only our {i}third{/i} was here as well...
lines.zh: : 现在，要是我们的{i}第三{/i}个也在这儿就好了……

lines.zh: {i}Yumi 获得了 $10,000！{/i}

lines.zh: {i}Tsubasa 获得了一只宠物！{/i}
